author: t. d. lam
title: Erie SeaWolves top Binghamton Rumble Ponies 10-2 with Izaac Pacheco in lineup
text:
The Erie SeaWolves, featuring former Friendswood High School standout Izaac Pacheco, earned a 10-2 victory over the Binghamton Rumble Ponies on Tuesday, June 23, at 6:05 p.m.
The matchup was held at UPMC Park for their seventh contest of the season, where Erie improved its season record against Binghamton to 5-2.
Pacheco finished 1-for-4 at the plate, notching 1 run, 1 RBI, striking out 3 times, and leaving 2 runners stranded.
The SeaWolves are set to play their next game at UPMC Park on Wednesday, June 24, also against the Erie SeaWolves.
